newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Fire wrecks part of historic Lisbon town hall.
newsitem.headline: Fire wrecks part of historic Lisbon town hall.

text.p: Fire wrecked the roof and upper storey of Lisbon's 18th century town hall on Thursday, provoking traffic chaos in the city centre but no victims, officials said.
Dozens of fire trucks were deployed to quell the blaze whose causes were not immediately known.
Firemen doused the front of the Bank of Portugal across the street from the town hall, but they succeeded in preventing the flames spreading to nearby buildings.
The town hall is set in the so-called 'Baixa' area of central Lisbon which was totally rebuilt in the mid-18th century after a devastating earthquake in 1755.
